text:
Aba, Akula's overprotective father, seems worried about her
making friends.

He seems determined to show off their family treasures and
make you understand that family bonds come before
friendship.
Take this opportunity to look at Akula's family treasures!

Aba is deeply shocked, thinking that Akula, whom he loves
dearly, has ignored him.

Believing that humans are responsible for it, he attacks you
without a second thought!
Let's knock some sense into him and get him to settle down!
[[N]]Check out the treasures in the Ocean Pantry
